assessment: The paper presents a streamlined new approach for functional validation of genes known to underlie fragile bone disorders in a relatively high throughput, using CRISPR-mediated knockouts and a number of phenotypic assessments in zebrafish. Convincing data demonstrate the feasibility and validity of this approach, which presents an important tool for rapid functional validation of candidate gene(s) associated with heritable bone diseases identified from genetic studies.
